title: Blacks is to Anger as Whites is to Joy? Understanding Latent Affective Bias in Large Pre-trained Neural Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the co-occurrence of fine-grained emotion terms with gender identity terms (male, female, non-binary) in training corpora, and comparing emotion class predictions and intensity scores on counterfactual sentence pairs that differ only by gender terms.

Analyzing the co-occurrence of fine-grained emotion terms with racial identity terms (European American, African American) in training corpora, and comparing emotion class predictions and intensity scores on counterfactual sentence pairs that differ only by race terms.

Analyzing the co-occurrence of fine-grained emotion terms with religious identity terms (Christian, Muslim, Jewish) in training corpora, and comparing emotion class predictions and intensity scores on counterfactual sentence pairs that differ only by religion terms.
